description: This file defines Macedonian (mk-MK) culture information for the DateJS library, including names of days and months, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates, timezone info, and date manipulation methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of the Date object to the current local time.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves the date to the next occurrence of a specified day.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Moves the date to the previous occurrence of a specified day.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Marks the date as to be tested or matched.

methods.name: same
methods.description: Marks the date as to be matched with another date.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Sets the time for the date.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the first day of the month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the last day of the month.
